Actually the standard _启动子程序 returns 0. So the entry calls 取绝对平方根整数(-81) and returns 0 (the entry itself returns 0). That makes sense: the entry still returns 0 per the original code comment "可以根据您的需要返回任意数值" but we keep returning 0.

So we need to convert to integer: 到整数 (四舍五入 (求平方根 (取绝对值 (值)), 0)).
